style: Epic painterly fantasy card illustration, highly detailed, cinematic composition, dramatic rim lighting and deep shadows, rich cosmic colour.
race: The Xel'Naru: beings of living crystal. Each is a figure of separate, hovering crystal shards (no flesh, no skin, no clothes of cloth) held together around a single blazing core of white light in the chest, the shards hanging a finger's width apart with light leaking through every gap. They float: below the waist the body trails off into a tapering spill of smaller shards that never touch the ground. The head is one tall, faceted crystal with two small points of white light for eyes and no other features. Their crystal is translucent and gem-like, mostly rose-pink, amethyst and soft violet, lit from within; some are ice-blue and frost-white instead (the cold ones), a few amber. They run hot: their cores flare white and their shards glow at the edges like heated glass, and many are cracked, with light bleeding from the fractures. Every Xel'Naru is an individual: vary size and build (slender, towering, hulking, small), the number, shape and colour of the shards, the core's colour, crests or crowns of crystal, heavy shoulder crystals, trailing capes of fine glittering shards, and how cracked they are. They are never human: no faces, no skin, no hair, no human hands or legs; every figure in the picture is a Xel'Naru.
framing: Wide 16:9 landscape. The painted scene fills the whole picture edge to edge: its sky or background continues right up to the top edge, with open sky across the top quarter (never a flat colour band, blank strip, letterbox bar, border or frame). The main figure's head sits about 40% of the way down and a little to one side of centre, never at the very top; keep faces and key details away from the bottom centre of the picture. The painting runs right to the bottom edge with no emblem, seal, logo, line or border anywhere. No text, no lettering.
